BP ko silent killer bolta hai.
High BP aapki arteries ki inner wall ko damage kar deti hai, yaani ki
endothelium jisko kehte hain. Endothelium ek single
silky layer hoti hai,
itni patli si hoti hai ki
matlab usko damage karna bahut aasaan ho jaata hai. Jab pressure bahut zyada ho jaata hai, toh ye layer toot jaati hai.
Wahin pe
LDL cholesterol jama hona shuru ho jaata hai, plaque ban jaata hai aur arteries tight ho jaati hain.
Heart ko zyada pump karna padta hai, aur heart ki wall
jo hoti hai, wo moti hoti hai.
Jo left ventricular hypertrophy hoti hai heart ki,
wo wahan ki baat ho rahi hai, wahan ka jo wall hota hai wo tight hota hai.
Aur
kidney ki chhoti si arteries jo hoti hain,
wo damage ho jaati hain.
Brain ki jo arteries hoti hain, wo bhi damage ho jaati hain.
Aur ye sab jo hota hai na, wo bina symptom ke hota hai,
